h1: Chatbot handoff that passes the chat to your team
overview: The moment a chatbot hands over is when customers judge your business. We set up clear triggers for handoff, such as a request for a person, anger, a payment issue or repeated confusion, and send the full conversation with a short summary to your team in email, Slack or your helpdesk. Out of hours, it takes contact details and promises a reply time you set.

faq: Can my staff reply in the same chat window?
Yes, in the Premium package, if your chat tool supports live takeover. Otherwise the reply goes by email or your helpdesk. We confirm what your tool allows before you order.
A direct request, strong frustration, topics like refunds or legal issues, and repeated failed answers. You choose the triggers, and we test each one with sample chats.
The assistant says no one is available, collects contact details and tells the customer when to expect a reply. The chat is waiting in your inbox when you open.
Does the customer need to repeat their problem?
No. The staff member sees the whole conversation and a short summary, so they can start from the issue, not from hello.
